description: Payout lifecycle vectors: every status transition and every refused one, lapse at the time to live and at an attestation's valid_until, who may cancel for each reason, agent removal, and transfer failures inside execute.

vectors.description: A payout at the approval threshold is PENDING, one approval makes it APPROVED, and the executor pays it, leaving an EXECUTED tombstone.
Payouts below the threshold are APPROVED on request and are executed by the agent, the principal and an executor.
Pending payouts are rejected by an approver and by the principal, releasing pending and leaving REJECTED tombstones.
A PENDING payout cannot be executed, by the agent or the principal, and stays reserved.
An APPROVED payout can be neither approved again nor rejected, by an approver or the principal.
Once EXECUTED, approve, reject, cancel by the principal or a third party, and execute are all PAYOUT_WRONG_STATUS.
Once REJECTED, approve, reject, cancel by the principal or a third party, and execute are all PAYOUT_WRONG_STATUS.
Once CANCELLED, approve, reject, cancel by the principal or a third party, and execute are all PAYOUT_WRONG_STATUS.
Every call on an ID with no record and no tombstone is PAYOUT_NOT_FOUND, a third party's cancel included, and the view reads null.
A payout expires one time to live after its request; one second before that it still executes.
A pending payout approved one second before it lapses becomes APPROVED and executes in that same second.
At its expiry a pending payout cannot be approved and an approved one cannot be executed; both stay reserved until anyone cancels them.
The principal cancels a pending and an approved payout with reason 1, releasing pending and committed.
The requesting agent cancels its own pending and approved payouts with reason 2.
Before a payout's own expiry no third party, approver, guardian or executor may cancel it; from that second anyone may, while the mandate is active.
Once a payout's own time to live has run out a third party cancels it with reason 3.
A second agent cannot cancel another agent's payout; the agent that requested it can.
An agent removed and added back holds a new epoch: it cannot cancel or execute its earlier payouts, while its new ones work.
Removing an agent stops its pending payout at approve and its approved payout at execute; the principal cancels both.
After the mandate expires a third party still waits for a payout's own expiry inside the grace, while the agent cancels at once.
An attested payout expires at its earliest leg valid_until, before its time to live; execute then is PAYOUT_LAPSED and anyone may cancel.
An attested payout capped at its attestation's valid_until still executes one second before it.
When the time to live ends before the attestation, an attested payout expires with its time to live.
The asset calls back into execute during the leg transfer and lets the refusal fail its transfer: execute is TRANSFER_FAILED and nothing changes.
The asset calls back into execute during the leg transfer and catches the refusal: execute completes as if no nested call was made.
When the second leg's destination cannot receive, execute is TRANSFER_FAILED and the first leg, already paid within the call, is reverted too.
The fee is transferred last; when the fee address cannot receive, execute is TRANSFER_FAILED and the legs are reverted with it.
A lapsed payout's record still reads back one second before the end of its one day margin, and a third party cancels it then.
Execute at a payout's expiry is PAYOUT_LAPSED, and the record stays readable and cancellable through its margin.
After revoke no payout can be cancelled, its record stays as it was, and revoke already released every reservation.
